title: When Is Smaller Greener? Right-Sizing Language Models for Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.19345v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents use a large language model (LLM) to plan and act over many steps. Which model should an agent use, so that its tasks are completed reliably with the least energy, cost and time? We treat this as a multi-criteria decision problem in which comparisons per call can mislead: a task succeeds only if all its steps succeed, and failed attempts still use resources. We therefore compare models on resources per successfully completed task. We derive crossover task lengths at which two models exchange their efficiency ranking, determined by their per-step reliability and resource use. Each objective has its own crossover. Below the shortest crossover the less reliable model dominates, above the longest the more reliable one dominates, and in between both are Pareto-efficient and preferences decide. translated_title: 何时更小更环保？为智能体AI选择合适规模的语言模型
translated_abstract: AI智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）在多个步骤中进行规划和行动。智能体应该使用哪种模型，才能以最少的能源、成本和时间可靠地完成任务？我们将此视为一个多准则决策问题，在这种问题中，按单次调用进行比较可能产生误导：只有当所有步骤都成功时任务才算成功，而失败的尝试仍然会消耗资源。因此，我们基于每个成功完成任务的资源消耗来比较模型。我们推导出了两个模型交换效率排名的交叉任务长度，该长度由它们每步的可靠性和资源消耗决定。每个目标都有自己的交叉点：在最短交叉点以下，可靠性较低的模型占优；在最长交叉点以上，可靠性较高的模型占优；在两者之间，两个模型都是帕累托有效的，由决策者偏好决定。这支持了一个两阶段框架：首先进行无偏好的占优筛选，然后对有效模型进行多准则排名
tldr: 该论文将智能体AI的模型选择视为多准则决策问题，提出以每个成功完成任务的资源消耗为比较标准，推导出模型效率排名互换的交叉任务长度，并构建了“无偏好占优筛选+多准则排名”的两阶段框架，指导如何根据任务长度为智能体选择合适规模的语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper derives crossover task lengths at which language models switch efficiency rankings based on resources per successfully completed task, and proposes a two-stage framework—preference-free dominance screening followed by multi-criteria ranking—to right-size LLMs for agentic AI.
